view: PA frontal chest radiograph, erect; L marker at image upper right confirms conventional orientation (patient's right on image left)
technical_quality: Adequate: full inspiration (about 9-10 posterior ribs), no significant rotation (spinous processes midway between clavicular heads), adequate penetration (thoracic spine visible through the heart). Scapulae partially project over the lateral upper lung fields. Costophrenic angles and lung apices included.

devices.type: External side marker 'L' with technologist label 'DG' (no line, tube, clip or pacemaker present)
devices.location: Image upper right corner, over the patient's left shoulder region

abnormalities.finding: Prominent, bulky right hilum with dense lobulated nodular opacities (~1.5 cm cluster, individual components ~1 cm), denser than adjacent vessels - suspicious for right hilar lymphadenopathy (possibly calcified nodes) versus a hilar/perihilar pulmonary nodule; the left hilum is normal by comparison
Small, very dense, well-circumscribed round nodule (~0.5 cm) in the medial right lower zone just above the right hemidiaphragm, most consistent with a calcified granuloma
Prominent, rounded aortic knob consistent with an unfolded/ectatic aortic arch; mediastinum otherwise not widened, trachea midline

description_zh: 正面（PA）胸部X光，吸氣量足夠、無明顯旋轉，未見任何導管、引流管或植入裝置，僅見左側「L」標記。右側肺門較左側明顯且呈分葉狀，可見約1.5公分之緻密結節狀陰影，需考慮右肺門淋巴結腫大（可能為鈣化淋巴結）或肺門旁結節；右下肺野內側橫膈上方另見一約0.5公分之緻密小結節，疑為鈣化肉芽腫。主動脈弓突出，心臟大小正常（心胸比約0.4），縱隔未增寬、氣管居中。雙側肋膈角銳利，無肋膜積液或氣胸；骨骼及軟組織無明顯異常，左橫膈下可見胃泡。
